title: KHR_gaussian_splatting_compression_spz_2
abstract:
This is a draft extension proposal for using [Niantic Spatial's SPZ compression library](https://github.com/nianticlabs/spz) for compression 3D Gaussian splatting data using the base [KHR_gaussian_splatting](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF/pull/2490) extension with glTF. This extension targets version 2 of SPZ.

As we get closer to done with the base extension for 3D Gaussian splatting, [KHR_gaussian_splatting](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF/pull/2490), it has made more and more sense to break out the `KHR_gaussian_splatting_compression_spz_2` extension for SPZ compression of 3DGS data. This allows them each to independently go through the ratification process and neither will hold up the other.

For previous history and conversations regarding the development of this extension, please look at the PR for [KHR_gaussian_splatting before this linked comment](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF/pull/2490#issuecomment-3348956097).
